The Orinian Empire, a Regional Power within the continent of [[Khalari]], who's status as a regional power is defined by great leadership and legacy. The Empire was established in 1680 by ''Ádám Bako'', the first Emperor of the [[Orinian Empire]]. Overtime the Empire would establish strong ties with other countries like the [[Union of Zhensanov]] and some of its neighbors. However, it is weary of the [[Ba'athist Republic of Volgastan]] due to the two competing as status for regional power on the continent. Additionally, the Orinian Empire has grown distrustful of the [[AGGPI]] due to recent actions and how they have handled them.
